run_format_mapping: run formatMapping.py with a magnum source path to generate VkFormat mapping header files
generate_format_mapping_hpp: generate formatMapping.hpp that maps VkFormat values to Magnum PixelFormat enums and suffixes
generate_compressed_format_mapping_hpp: generate compressedFormatMapping.hpp that maps VkFormat values to Magnum CompressedPixelFormat enums and suffixes
parse_vulkan_formats: parse VK_FORMAT enum values and their numeric IDs from the flextVk.h Vulkan header file
partition_formats: partition parsed format entries into compressed and uncompressed groups using the partition utility function
